name: moh731V2023HivPositiveMothersBase
description: MOH 731 (Ver. July 2023) 2.6 Infant Prophylaxis, step 3: the common list of HIV-positive pregnant and postnatal women -- women whose test at ANC, L&D or PNC came back positive (the 1.1 HIV Tests rules), and women known positive at an ANC visit -- one row per encounter and at most one per woman per day (moh731V2023HivPositiveMotherDays), with which of the two each row is and whether infant prophylaxis was given. Carries a flag per 2.6 figure (prophylaxis given, by service), which the aggregate sums and the patient list filters on.

join.joinCondition: fhs.person_id = b.patient_id AND fhs.is_clinical_encounter = 1 AND fhs.next_clinical_datetime_hiv IS NULL
drug_cn.concept_id = drug.value_coded AND drug_cn.locale_preferred = 1 AND drug_cn.voided = 0
pn.person_name_id = (SELECT pn2.person_name_id FROM amrs.person_name pn2 WHERE pn2.person_id = p.person_id AND pn2.voided = 0 ORDER BY pn2.preferred DESC, pn2.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1)

expressionOptions.expression: CASE WHEN (b.res_id IS NOT NULL AND fr.value_coded = 703 AND ((b.service = 'Maternity' AND b.has_valid_tt = 1 AND NOT (b.has_initial = 0 AND b.has_positive = 1)) OR (b.service = 'ANC' AND b.tt_id IS NOT NULL AND b.has_revisit = 0) OR (b.service = 'PNC' AND b.tt_id IS NOT NULL))) THEN 'Newly positive' ELSE 'Known positive' END
CASE WHEN b.service = 'PNC' THEN DATE(dd.value_datetime) END
(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = p.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 8 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = p.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 28 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = p.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 45 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)
CASE WHEN fhs.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

CASE WHEN (b.proph_val = 1065 AND ((b.res_id IS NOT NULL AND fr.value_coded = 703 AND ((b.service = 'Maternity' AND b.has_valid_tt = 1 AND NOT (b.has_initial = 0 AND b.has_positive = 1)) OR (b.service = 'ANC' AND b.tt_id IS NOT NULL AND b.has_revisit = 0) OR (b.service = 'PNC' AND b.tt_id IS NOT NULL))) OR ((b.service = 'ANC' AND b.kp_12019 = 1) AND b.anc_visit_number = 1))) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

CASE WHEN (b.proph_val = 1065 AND ((b.res_id IS NOT NULL AND fr.value_coded = 703 AND ((b.service = 'Maternity' AND b.has_valid_tt = 1 AND NOT (b.has_initial = 0 AND b.has_positive = 1)) OR (b.service = 'ANC' AND b.tt_id IS NOT NULL AND b.has_revisit = 0) OR (b.service = 'PNC' AND b.tt_id IS NOT NULL))) OR ((b.service = 'ANC' AND b.kp_12019 = 1) AND b.anc_visit_number = 1))) THEN drug_cn.name END

IF(b.service = 'ANC' AND (b.proph_val = 1065 AND ((b.res_id IS NOT NULL AND fr.value_coded = 703 AND ((b.service = 'Maternity' AND b.has_valid_tt = 1 AND NOT (b.has_initial = 0 AND b.has_positive = 1)) OR (b.service = 'ANC' AND b.tt_id IS NOT NULL AND b.has_revisit = 0) OR (b.service = 'PNC' AND b.tt_id IS NOT NULL))) OR ((b.service = 'ANC' AND b.kp_12019 = 1) AND b.anc_visit_number = 1))), 1, NULL)

IF(b.service = 'Maternity' AND (b.proph_val = 1065 AND ((b.res_id IS NOT NULL AND fr.value_coded = 703 AND ((b.service = 'Maternity' AND b.has_valid_tt = 1 AND NOT (b.has_initial = 0 AND b.has_positive = 1)) OR (b.service = 'ANC' AND b.tt_id IS NOT NULL AND b.has_revisit = 0) OR (b.service = 'PNC' AND b.tt_id IS NOT NULL))) OR ((b.service = 'ANC' AND b.kp_12019 = 1) AND b.anc_visit_number = 1))), 1, NULL)

IF(b.service = 'PNC' AND (b.proph_val = 1065 AND ((b.res_id IS NOT NULL AND fr.value_coded = 703 AND ((b.service = 'Maternity' AND b.has_valid_tt = 1 AND NOT (b.has_initial = 0 AND b.has_positive = 1)) OR (b.service = 'ANC' AND b.tt_id IS NOT NULL AND b.has_revisit = 0) OR (b.service = 'PNC' AND b.tt_id IS NOT NULL))) OR ((b.service = 'ANC' AND b.kp_12019 = 1) AND b.anc_visit_number = 1))), 1, NULL)

conditions.conditionExpression: ((b.res_id IS NOT NULL AND fr.value_coded = 703 AND ((b.service = 'Maternity' AND b.has_valid_tt = 1 AND NOT (b.has_initial = 0 AND b.has_positive = 1)) OR (b.service = 'ANC' AND b.tt_id IS NOT NULL AND b.has_revisit = 0) OR (b.service = 'PNC' AND b.tt_id IS NOT NULL))) OR (b.service = 'ANC' AND b.kp_12019 = 1))
